September 19, 2026
Ottawa, Ontario

Note: All times local and subject to change

Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, France

12:30 p.m. The Prime Minister will arrive in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, France.

Note for media:

  • Pooled photo opportunity

12:45 p.m. The Prime Minister will attend a working lunch with the President of France, Emmanuel Macron.

Closed to media

2:30 p.m. The Prime Minister will participate in a wreath-laying ceremony alongside the President of France, Emmanuel Macron.

Note for media:

  • Pooled photo opportunity

2:55 p.m. The Prime Minister will deliver a joint statement with the President of France, Emmanuel Macron.

Note for media:

  • Open coverage

3:30 p.m. The Prime Minister will depart for Ottawa, Canada.

Note for media:

  • Pooled photo opportunity

National Capital Region, Canada

3:45 p.m. The Prime Minister will arrive in Ottawa, Canada.

Closed to media

4:45 p.m. The Prime Minister will welcome the Prime Minister of Norway, Jonas Gahr Støre.

Mackenzie Doors
West Block
Parliament Hill

Notes for media:

  • Open coverage

  • Media wishing to cover the event must be accredited with the Canadian Parliamentary Press Gallery.

5:00 p.m. The Prime Minister will meet with the Prime Minister of Norway, Jonas Gahr Støre.

Third floor
West Block
Parliament Hill

Note for media:

  • Pooled photo opportunity at the beginning of the meeting

6:15 p.m. The Prime Minister will deliver brief remarks and participate in a joint media availability with the Prime Minister of Norway, Jonas Gahr Støre.

Third floor
West Block
Parliament Hill

Notes for media:

  • Open coverage

  • Media wishing to cover the event must be accredited with the Canadian Parliamentary Press Gallery and are asked to arrive no later than 5:30 p.m.
